label: 038 post-hoc addition: causal a trous (Haar) multiscale forecast (Renaud, Starck & Murtagh 2005)
status: POST-HOC: added after the 038 verdicts were read, at the user's request; committed before any a trous result. Replaces the periodic-boundary SWT inputs of lgb_LW as the sound test of wavelet forecasting. Same rule, costs, folds, purge, training rows and scorer as preregistration.json.
transform: causal Haar a trous on log close, 5 levels: c_j(t) = (c_{j-1}(t) + c_{j-1}(t - 2^(j-1)))/2, w_j = c_{j-1} - c_j; one-sided, no padding
inputs_AT: w_j(t) and w_j(t - 2^j) for j = 1..5; c_5(t) - c_5(t - 32); lc(t) - c_5(t) (12 inputs); must pass the truncation test

ridge_AT.params: Ridge(alpha=1.0) on standardised AT (scaler per training span): the paper's multiscale AR, direct N-step target

lgb_AT.seed: a PASS needs a seed-2 PASS

lgb_LAT.seed: a PASS needs a seed-2 PASS
